description: Given a company URL or id, return engagers (across your collected posts) who have a position at that company. Relation filter: 'coworker' = current employees, 'alumni' = any past or current position (most useful for page_type='SCHOOL' companies), 'any' = both. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.

relation.description: coworker = current employees only; alumni = any position (past or current); any = both

name: get_alumni_engagers
title: Alumni / Coworker Engagers for a Company
